GSE37250.location: Methods: Study Participants; Peripheral Blood RNA Expression by Microarray
GSE37250.case_definition: Culture from sputum or tissue; exclusively pulmonary disease is not established for the current subset.
GSE37250.control_definition: TB considered and excluded; clinical grouping adjudicated by two experienced clinicians. Current individual OD diagnoses not available.
GSE37250.population: Adults in South Africa and Malawi; original HIV-positive and negative groups; current subset HIV-negative.
GSE37250.timing: Original protocol: before or within 24 hours of treatment; individual current-record timing not verified.
GSE37250.unresolved: Current anatomical case subtype and OD diagnosis-specific composition.

GSE39939.case_definition: Kenyan validation children; culture-confirmed and culture-negative clinical TB. Diagnostic algorithm permits pulmonary and extrapulmonary presentations.
GSE39939.control_definition: Alternative diagnosis, negative cultures and well at follow-up without TB therapy; Kenyan OD group permitted IGRA positivity. Current OD-specific diagnoses unresolved.
GSE39939.population: Suspected TB in hospital children younger than 15; current subset HIV-negative.
GSE39939.timing: Sample timing relative to first treatment not independently resolved for current records.
GSE39939.unresolved: Current pulmonary-only status; detailed OD diagnoses and culture-negative certainty subgroups.

GSE39940.case_definition: South African/Malawian discovery children; original discovery contrasted culture-confirmed TB; individual culture confirmation not populated in current task metadata.
GSE39940.control_definition: Original discovery OD selection excluded IGRA-positive children. Record-specific alternative diagnoses unresolved.
GSE39940.population: Hospital children younger than 15; current subset HIV-negative.
GSE39940.unresolved: Per-record confirmation, anatomical subtype and detailed OD diagnoses.

GSE73408.location: Materials and Methods: Study design, Microarray analysis; Table 1; data accession
GSE73408.control_definition: Original profiled comparison contains 39 community-acquired pneumonia participants; clinical/radiographic CAP criteria and negative QuantiFERON. Current curated PneumoniaStatus is negative for all 39 OD records: unresolved coding conflict.
GSE73408.population: HIV-uninfected adults, Colorado/Texas outpatient enrolment; prospective case-control design.
GSE73408.timing: Blood timing relative to initial therapy unresolved.
GSE73408.unresolved: Per-sample pneumonia mapping conflicts with curated code; retain original task labels and show paper-level composition separately.

GSE83456.location: Methods: Clinical cohorts; Microarray; supporting Tables S2/S3
GSE83456.case_definition: Original study includes pulmonary and extrapulmonary TB, with culture, histology and/or clinical/radiological response-based diagnosis. Current task selects 45 PTB-labelled records, not the original EPTB group.
GSE83456.control_definition: Sarcoidosis: mediastinal histology and compatible clinical/radiological findings with negative mycobacterial culture.
GSE83456.population: London cohorts; immunosuppression including HIV excluded; some participants selected from an existing RNA bank.
GSE83456.unresolved: Culture-only status of all 45 selected PTB-labelled records not verified from individual source records.

GSE89403.case_definition: Original CTRC newly diagnosed sputum-culture-confirmed pulmonary TB; current task uses baseline TB-labelled records.
GSE89403.control_definition: The current 17 OD-labelled records cannot be fully mapped to the control definitions in the main article. LungDxStatus is positive in 9 and negative in 8; neither value identifies a specific alternative diagnosis.
GSE89403.population: Original cases: HIV-uninfected adults, Cape Town primary-care clinics.
GSE89403.timing: Original case transcriptomes before treatment and longitudinally; current 108 records carry Baseline.
GSE89403.unresolved: Exact identities, diagnoses and TB-exclusion criteria of all 17 OD-labelled records; no new clinical claim inferred from numeric Xpert/MGIT fields.
